## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Verification

- [ ] Frontend type-check and tests pass (`npm run typecheck && npm test`)
- [ ] Backend tests pass (`cd backend && python -m pytest -q`)
- [ ] Production build succeeds (`npm run build`)
- [ ] User-facing changes include screenshots or recordings where useful

## Risk and rollout

Describe migrations, configuration changes, compatibility concerns, and rollback steps. Write `None` when not applicable.

## Security checklist

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or private user data are committed
- [ ] Authentication, authorization, validation, and logging impacts were considered
